newsitem.title: CHINA: China's ageing population to increase faster.
newsitem.headline: China's ageing population to increase faster.

text.p: One in every four Chinese will be over 60 years old by the middle of the century as the pace of the growth of China's ageing population accelerates, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The size of China's ageing population is expected to increase to 132 million by the turn of the century, compared with a current 120 million, Xinhua said quoting experts from the Chinese Association of the Elderly.
That figure would climb to 374 million by the year 2040, accounting for 24.48 percent of the total population, they said.
"The increasing scale of the aging population in China is probably the largest in the world," it said.

Since 1990, the elderly population has climbed by 3.32 percent a year while in big cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Tianjin. Booming coastal provinces of Jiangsu and Shandong have reported evern higher rates of increase, it said.

Better health conditions and higher living standards have resulted in average life expectancy of Chinese doubling to 70 years, from just 35 in 1949. In Beijing, life expectancy has reached 74 years, Xinhua said.
China's population of more than 1.2 billion is the largest in the world.
